findings.current: Perhaps pouring out all his strength had left him too exhausted to notice at first.
findings.defect: The English omits Jeok Cheongang’s retrospective observation that things had seemed strange from the start and his question about how such a thick, vast cloud of steam could have formed. Those details are part of the clues leading him to identify the cold qi.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly includes both the retrospective observation and the question about the steam’s formation before asking why the enemies beyond it showed no reaction.
findings.replacement: Perhaps pouring out all his strength had left him too exhausted to notice at first. Looking back, things had been strange from the start. How had such a thick, vast cloud of steam formed?

summary: The translation is broadly faithful, but it omits part of Jeok Cheongang’s reasoning as he recognizes the cold qi.
